questions.question_text: For $a=-\dfrac{5}{2}$ and $b=\dfrac{7}{4}$, evaluate the LHS and RHS of $|a+b|\le|a|+|b|$. Which pair of values checks the inequality?

questions.solution_text:
$\text{LHS}=\left|-\dfrac52+\dfrac74\right|$
$\text{LHS}=\left|-\dfrac{10}{4}+\dfrac74\right|$
$\text{LHS}=\left|-\dfrac34\right|$
$\text{LHS}=\dfrac34$
$\text{RHS}=\left|-\dfrac52\right|+\left|\dfrac74\right|$
$\text{RHS}=\dfrac52+\dfrac74$
$\text{RHS}=\dfrac{17}{4}$
Since $\dfrac34\le\dfrac{17}{4}$, the inequality holds for these values.
